April 9 37.

My dear Hill,

With reference to your letter dated 2nd
April, 1937, enquiries show that Noclo Izaak Steinmetz
disembarked from the S.S. "Franconia" in Bangkok.
Nothing is known regarding his activities and as far
as it can be ascertained he has not previously visited
Shanghai.

Henry Klug arrived in Shanghai on board the
S.S. "Franconia" on April 9. He is in possession of
a through ticket to New York. He gave the following
particulars regarding himself on the Aliens' Declaration
Form furnished to him by the Chinese Authorities:-

Name : Henry Horace Klug
Nationality: French
Born : In France, October 19, 1893.
Profession : Insurance Inspector.
Passport : French No.29284 issued on June 25,1936,
in Paris.

Klug visited Shanghai about a year ago on a similar
tour around the world.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne

F.L. Hill, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

1937年4月9日。

亲爱的希尔：

关于你1937年4月2日的来信，经查，诺克洛·伊扎克·斯坦梅茨（Noclo Izaak Steinmetz）在曼谷从“弗兰科尼亚”号轮船（S.S. "Franconia"）下船。
对其活动一无所知，且据查他此前未曾到访过上海。

亨利·克鲁格（Henry Klug）于4月9日乘坐“弗兰科尼亚”号轮船抵达上海。他持有前往纽约的联程票。他在中国当局提供的外国人申报表中提供了以下个人信息：-

姓名：亨利·霍勒斯·克鲁格
国籍：法国
出生：1893年10月19日生于法国。
职业：保险稽查员。
护照：法国第29284号，1936年6月25日签发于巴黎。

克鲁格约在一年前曾以类似的环球旅行方式访问过上海。

此致，

（签名）K. M. 伯恩

F.L. 希尔先生，
英国驻沪总领事馆，
上海。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I. Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. S. D. 7862
10 4 37
Date April 9. 1937.

Subject Nocio Isaak STEINMETZ and Henry KLUG: enquiry from the
British Consulate-General.

Made by D. S. Lockwood. Forwarded by T. Boyne D.S.I.

With reference to the enquiry from the British Consulate-
General dated April 2. 1937, regarding a NOCIO IZAAK STEINMETZ,
I have to report that this person disembarked from the
s.s. 'Franconia' in Bangkok. Enquiries show that there is
nothing known regarding his activities. As far as it can be
ascertained he has not previously visited Shanghai.

With reference to the enquiry regarding HENRY KLUG, I
have to report that he arrived in Shanghai on board the s.s
'Franconia' on April 9. 1937 and that he is in possession of a
through ticket to New York. He gave the following particulars
regarding himself on the Aliens' Declaration Form furnished him
by the Chinese authorities.

Name: Henry Horace KLUG.
Nationality French.
Born In France, October 19.1893.
Profession Insurance Inspector
Passport. French.No.29284 issued on June 25.
1936 in Paris.

Enquiries show that there is nothing known regarding this
individual. He visited Shanghai approximately one year ago on
a similar tour around the world.

F. D. Lockwood.
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

日期 1937年4月9日。

主题 诺西奥·伊萨克·斯坦梅茨（Nocio Isaak STEINMETZ）和亨利·克鲁格（Henry KLUG）：英国总领事馆的查询。

由 D. S. 洛克伍德（Lockwood）编制。由 T. 博因（Boyne） D.S.I. 转发。

关于英国总领事馆1937年4月2日就诺西奥·伊扎克·斯坦梅茨（NOCIO IZAAK STEINMETZ）一事提出的查询，兹报告此人已在曼谷从“弗兰科尼亚”号轮船下船。调查显示，对其活动一无所知。据查，他此前未曾到访过上海。

关于对亨利·克鲁格（HENRY KLUG）的查询，兹报告他于1937年4月9日乘坐“弗兰科尼亚”号轮船抵达上海，并持有前往纽约的联程票。他在中国当局提供的外国人申报表中提供了以下个人信息。

姓名：亨利·霍勒斯·克鲁格。
国籍 法国。
出生 1893年10月19日生于法国。
职业 保险稽查员
护照. 法国.第29284号，1936年6月25日签发于巴黎。

调查显示，对此人一无所知。他约在一年前曾以类似的环球旅行方式访问过上海。

F. D. 洛克伍德。
D. S.
副总监（特别支部）。

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.

Secret & Personal.

2nd April 1937.

My dear Bourne,

Nocio Izaak STEINMETZ and Henry KLUG are
passengers on board the s.s. "Franconia" which is on a round
the world cruise.

Steinmetz is mentioned in the Home Office Suspect
List. He was not allowed to land in Colombo and Singapore and
unconfirmed information has been received to the effect that
Klug is a Communist.

Any information which you may be able to obtain
regarding these two men would be of great interest.

Yours Sincerely,

Major K.M. Bourne M.C.,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

D.S. Lockwood
J.B. 2/4

（印：BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL 2 APR. 37 SHANGHAI）

英国驻沪总领事馆，
邮政信箱 259. 上海。

秘密及个人信件。

1937年4月2日。

亲爱的伯恩：

诺西奥·伊扎克·斯坦梅茨（Nocio Izaak STEINMETZ）和亨利·克鲁格（Henry KLUG）是正在进行环球巡航的“弗兰科尼亚”号轮船上的乘客。

斯坦梅茨被列入英国内政部嫌疑人名单。他不获准在科伦坡和新加坡登陆，且收到未经证实的消息称克鲁格是一名共产党员。

若能获取有关这两人的任何信息，将极具价值。

此致，

K.M. 伯恩少校 M.C.，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路，
上海。

D.S. 洛克伍德
J.B. 2/4

（印：英国驻沪总领事馆 1937年4月2日 上海）
